references.text: God remembers his covenant with Jacob, Isaac, and Abraham, showing that he will not completely reject his people
The Lord is a merciful God who will not abandon or destroy his people, and he will not forget the covenant he made with the fathers
God will not fail or forsake his people, even in enemy lands
The Lord will not reject his people for the sake of his great name
God showed mercy to Israel and turned to them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
In his great compassion, God did not bring them to an end or abandon them, for he is a gracious and merciful God
God has chosen Israel and has not rejected them, even from the ends of the earth
God will not completely destroy Israel, even though he disciplines them
God will not reject the descendants of Jacob because of his covenant, but will show mercy
God pleads not to forsake his people for the sake of his name and not to dishonor the throne of his glory
Paul confirms that God has not rejected his people whom he knew from the beginning
God's gifts and calling are irrevocable, and all Israel will be saved because of the covenant
